nextStoryContext: US-003 is complete. ConfigScreen.tsx is a multi-step Ink wizard (6 phase steps + backend step) reusing Select.tsx and Section.tsx. mergeConfigChoices writes [models] section (one key per phase) and [backend] section (name key) to project.toml via mergeIntoConfig without clobbering issue_system/issue_prefix. readBackend was updated to handle both scalar form (backward compat) and [backend] section form. index.ts registers 'config' in HELP and dispatches to runConfig. Next story is US-004 or whichever has the next lowest priority with passes:false.
